issue.title: Brand Android app launch: Fluent launcher icon + native splash
issue.body:
## Summary

Brand the Android app launch experience with the **Fluent launcher icon** and a **native splash screen**.

## What shipped

- Fluent launcher icon assets wired into the Android app.
- Native splash screen (BootSplash) configuration so the app shows Fluent branding on cold start.

## Attribution

Delivered by @mattrace-gloo in [PR #58](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/58) (merged).

## Status

**Completed** — closing as completed. Tracking/credit issue.

Refs #58.
